title: Atom Holdings entered compulsory liquidation in the Cayman Islands
description: The Singapore High Court later recorded that Atom Holdings, the Cayman parent within the AAX Group, had been placed under compulsory liquidation in the Cayman Islands as of 2023-07-11, with Quantuma-appointed liquidators. This parent-company liquidation is recorded separately from the later winding up of AAX Asia and AAX Singapore.
notes: Entity-scoped lifecycle event. It does not establish that every AAX group entity entered the same proceeding on this date, and it does not establish a customer recovery percentage or completed distribution.
